members.body: Acme said quarterly revenue rose 18% as chip orders accelerated. CEO Dana Lee said "AI server demand strengthened through April."

payload.headline: Acme chip orders accelerate on AI server demand.
payload.thesis_line: AI server demand supports semiconductor suppliers over the next several weeks.
payload.what_changed: Acme reported faster revenue growth and stronger AI server orders.

overview.text: Acme reported an 18% quarterly revenue increase tied to chip orders.

claims.text: Chip orders accelerated during the quarter.

quotes.text: AI server demand strengthened through April.
quotes.speaker: Dana Lee
